title: Python Language Reference map
summary: Route core-language questions to the correct reference family.

routes.lexical: lexical analysis: line structure, identifiers, literals, operators and delimiters
routes.objects: data model: objects, values, types, hierarchy and special method names
routes.binding: execution model: naming, binding, scopes and namespaces
routes.expressions: expressions, evaluation order, comparisons, identity and precedence
routes.statements: simple/compound statements, assignment, functions, classes, with, match and exceptions
routes.imports: import system: searching, loading, packages and sys.path

next: If the question names a module or class API, move to the Standard Library rather than extending a grammar answer.
